Subject: Q2 payment expectations — invoice RW-2026-318 (VAT breakdown attached)

Hi Liam —

Quick follow-up from our Friday demo: attached is invoice RW-2026-318 for the June usage run (PDF attached). We noted the card attempt on file failed during processing this morning, so I wanted to surface a couple of short options to keep things moving to close this quarter:

1) Expedited wire: we can provide same-day wire instructions — please confirm beneficiary name and expected send time; we’ll mark the invoice as pending remit once funds are visible.
2) ACH authorization: if you prefer ACH, we need the attached ACH form signed back to rishi_malhotra@redwood.com.
3) Split remit: if part of the invoice can be covered by CC and remainder wired, we can reissue a pro-forma split invoice.

I’ve attached a VAT summary and Redwood's VAT certificate to help payroll/ AP reconcile the tax lines. If you can confirm which route you want by EOD tomorrow (Tue 7/6), we’ll queue the reissue and collections routing.

Attachments: invoice-RW-2026-318.pdf, redwood-vat-certificate.pdf

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 payment expectations — invoice RW-2026-318 (VAT breakdown attached)

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up. Our AP saw the failed card attempt — our procurement policy requires wire for all vendor invoices > $50k, so we can’t retry the CC. Two quick asks from our side before we schedule the wire:

- Can you reissue the invoice showing the VAT amount on a separate line and include your company VAT registration number in the invoice header? The finance team needs that for our tax coding.
- Please confirm beneficiary bank details (full account name, routing, SWIFT) and whether Redwood accepts EUR wires to the same account (we may send GBP/EUR depending on the originating bank).

Assuming those are in place, I’ll push this through our expedited wire window (we have a 48-hour outbound SLA for vendor wires once paperwork is complete).

Also copying AP so they have context.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Finance Manager — Beckman Biotech
liam.oconnor@beckmanbiotech.com

Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 payment expectations — invoice RW-2026-318 (VAT breakdown attached)

Thanks Liam —

I’m Marissa from Collections — I’ll coordinate the reissue and wire confirmation. Quick answers:

- We can reissue the invoice with VAT on its own line and include Redwood's VAT registration (attached VAT certificate).
- Wire details: attached "wire-instructions-PRN.docx" contains USD and EUR rails and SWIFT; beneficiary name is "Redwood Inference Inc.". If you will be sending EUR, note the intermediary bank listed for EUR transfers — there is sometimes a 1–2 business day routing hold.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 7/6 10:00am PT: we send reissued invoice (PDF) to AP
- Tue 7/6 by 4:00pm PT: you confirm requested payment currency and expected send time
- Wed 7/7 by EOD: Redwood reconciles incoming funds and releases access hold (if any)

If you prefer a split remit, I can prepare a short pro-forma with the CC portion + wire portion and route to your AP for signoff.

Attachments: wire-instructions-PRN.docx, redwood-vat-certificate.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa/Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. AP confirms they will route a USD wire tomorrow morning (Thu 7/8) once they receive the reissued invoice. Two confirmations from our side:

1) Beneficiary name and account details in the wire-instructions-PRN.docx look correct.
2) We need the invoice reissue to reference purchase order PO-98821 for our internal matching.

If you can send the updated invoice now (with VAT line + PO reference), I’ll flag it for priority processing. We expect funds to hit Redwood's account within 24–36 hours after send.

Liam
